hypothesis: Atomic evidence ancestry plus deterministic closed-world admission can prevent unsupported claims from entering durable reusable memory while retaining enough grounded knowledge for successful transfer.
admission_rule: Each durable claim must cite exactly one valid evidence atom and must equal that canonical atom after minimal normalization.
